texts.zh:
我们在[from.target.capital_scope.GetName]的特工以先进的知识武装头脑，已经渗透了当地的大学，凭借着开创性的理论确立了自己作为杰出思想家的地位。然而，此人不断取得的成功却遭到了当地学者的质疑：许多人拒绝与此人接触，指责其为骗子。

无休止的学术争吵阻碍了我们的特工传播新思想。我们的间谍首脑正在请求进一步的指示。
texts.en:
Armed with our superior knowledge, our operatives on [from.target.capital_scope.GetName] have infiltrated local universities, establishing themselves as brilliant thinkers known for their ground-breaking theories. Their rising success, though, has been met with suspicion by local scholars: many refuse to engage with them, accusing them of being frauds.

The endless academic bickering is making it hard for our agents to spread new ideas. Our Spymaster is requesting further instructions.

label.zh: 用一些更极端的手段贿赂这些学者：科研经费。
label.en: Bribe these scholars with something radical: funding.

label.zh: 让他们吵去吧。这肯定会很有趣的。
label.en: Let them bicker. This could prove interesting.

texts.zh:
最近几周，许多反对我们特工理论的学者不得不离开他们的职位，随后又发生了一系列看似无关的——有时还相当暴力的——“意外事件”。

哎呀，我们的这一计谋有失精妙，让特工们招致猜疑。他们大多都被踢出了[from.target.GetSpeciesAdj]的学院，而他们的位置很快就填上了一些较为保守的思想家。
texts.en:
Many of the academics who had opposed our operatives' theories have had to leave their positions in recent weeks, following a string of seemingly unrelated - and occasionally quite violent - "accidents".

Alas, our machinations lacked subtlety, and have brought a great deal of suspicion down upon our operatives. Most have been barred from [from.target.GetSpeciesAdj] academia, their vacant spots immediately filled by more conservative thinkers.

texts.zh: 最近几周，许多反对我们特工理论的学者不得不离开他们的职位，随后又发生了一系列看似无关的——有时还相当暴力的——“意外事件”。
texts.en: Many of the academics who had opposed our operatives' theories have had to leave their positions in recent weeks, following a string of seemingly unrelated - and occasionally quite violent - "accidents".

label.zh: 很好。这就是我们的下马威。

tooltips.zh: [from.GetName]行动将恢复，并趋向获得更积极的结果。
tooltips.en: Operation [from.GetName] will resume, trending towards a more positive outcome.

texts.zh: 我们在[from.target.capital_scope.GetName]上贿赂异见学者的企图瞬间就被发现并报道了。当地司法部门行动迅速：许多我们的特工被从学院里扫地出门。他们的空位迅速被较为保守的[from.target.GetSpeciesAdj]思想家占领了。
texts.en: Our attempt to bribe dissenting academics on [from.target.capital_scope.GetName] was immediately discovered and reported. Local justice has proven swift: a number of our operatives have been barred from academia. Their vacant spots have already been filled by more conservative [from.target.GetSpeciesAdj] thinkers.

tooltips.zh: [from.GetName]行动将克服该负面障碍继续进行。
tooltips.en: Operation [from.GetName] will resume despite this negative setback.

texts.zh:
得益于一位慷慨大方的匿名赞助人，当地学者们的研究经费终于有了着落：这馅饼掉得太突然，以至于连琐碎竞争的时间都没有。

新近的繁荣也创造力一些新的学术岗位，并很快被我们的特工占领了。我们逐渐抓紧了对[from.target.GetSpeciesAdj]学院的控制，使其更便于传播我们的理念。
texts.en:
Thanks to the generosity of an anonymous patron, local academics have been able to secure funding for their research: an unexpected boon that leaves little time for petty rivalries.

This newfound prosperity brought with it new academic positions, rapidly filled by more of our operatives. Our grip on [from.target.GetSpeciesAdj] academia tightens, making it that bit easier to spread our ideas.

texts.zh: 在[from.target.capital_scope.GetName]上无休止的学术争论果然是一大阻碍，而非什么机遇。我们的特工没能在[from.target.capital_scope.GetPlanetHabitat]的主要文化学院中占得一席之地。也许我们尝试带去的理念在目前还是太具争议了。
texts.en: The seemingly endless academic feuds on [from.target.capital_scope.GetName] have proven to be more of a hindrance than an opportunity. Our operatives failed to gain a foothold at any of the [from.target.capital_scope.GetPlanetHabitat]'s main cultural institutions. Perhaps the ideas we tried to introduce were just too controversial at this time.

tooltips.zh: [from.GetName]行动将克服该负面障碍继续进行。
tooltips.en: Operation [from.GetName] will resume despite this negative setback.

texts.zh:
我们白捡了一个好机会！我们的特工在与[from.target.GetName]的思想家争论的过程中，发现自己被一些最尖锐的对手推到了一个人尽皆知的地步。结果就是，我们的理念现在被带到了[from.target.capital_scope.GetName]上最受尊敬的学术机构代表面前。

这些机构不但理解了我们的思想，而且还开始开始对其提炼，并变成一些意想不到的东西：一些可能是经过混沌的意见交换后产生的新见解。
texts.en:
An ideal opportunity has come our way! While debating with local thinkers, our operatives in the [from.target.GetName] found themselves thrust onto a highly prestigious stage by some of their fiercest rivals. As a result, our ideas have now been brought before representatives from the most respected academic institutions on [from.target.capital_scope.GetName].

These bodies not only understood our ideas, but have since set about refining them, turning them into something quite unexpected: new insights, made possible through the chaotic exchange of ideas.

## 如何开始 How it starts

随机插曲池（`espionage_event_effects.txt:2908–3260`）：按‘我方普通/格式塔 × 目标普通/蜂巢’分四个池，池内各项权重 1：普通→普通、蜂巢（普通）→普通。出现的概率：章节检定失败时 10/400（无外貌改造科技 ×1.5），同一行动 120 天一次。本事件的限制：章节≤3，行动不是渗透政府/提高觉醒度/散布虚假信息。 / Fired from the roll-failure interlude pool (普通→普通、蜂巢（普通）→普通): 10-in-400 chance per failed chapter roll, once per 120 days per operation. Restrictions: Chapter ≤3, not infiltrate-government, increase-awareness or spread-disinformation.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

**学术追求（3040）**：特工渗入大学。A 清除竞争者 → 50/50 **3041 事故**（−1）/ **3042**（+1）；B 用资金收买学者 → 50/50 **3043 资助研究**（−1，被发现）/ **3044**（+1）；C 让他们争吵 → 50/50 **3045 无休止的辩论**（−1）/ **3046**（+1）。 / Academic Pursuits (3040): A eliminate rivals → 3041 (−1) or 3042 (+1); B bribe scholars → 3043 (−1) or 3044 (+1); C let them bicker → 3045 (−1) or 3046 (+1).
